subject: FinServCo — access control cogplan & security handshake for onboarding
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finservco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finservco.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: FinServCo onboarding — access controls kickoff and evidence request

Hi Ben / Marissa / Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Per our internal security checklist, we need to kick off the access-control portion of the onboarding (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist, and service account patterns). To unblock procurement and our security review I can share a prioritized list of what we need from Redwood: 

- SAML metadata (EntityID, ACS URL, certificate) and a short note on session durations / clock skew assumptions
- SCIM support: attribute map (which attributes you provision by default), and whether group push is supported
- IP ranges we should allow for egress callbacks and admin console access (we currently restrict to a small set of CIDRs)
- Service account flow for server-to-server ingestion (sample policy + expected roles)
- Any org-level policies you recommend (session TTL, 2FA enforcement, retention defaults)

I've attached our Security RFI to show the items the security team will ask for. We aim to complete this by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-24) to hit our internal go/no-go on licensing.

Can we schedule a focused 30–40 minute technical handshake tomorrow to align owners and handoffs? Please propose times.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Head of IT Security, FinServCo

Attachment: FinServCo_Security_RFI.xlsx (spreadsheet with questionnaire)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finservco.com>

Subject: Re: FinServCo onboarding — access controls kickoff and evidence request

Maria — thanks, this is perfect.

We can cover the checklist in a single technical handshake. Proposed agenda (30–40m):

1) SAML metadata & cert exchange (owner: Karthik)
2) SCIM attribute map and group handling (owner: Neha)
3) IP allowlist and egress callbacks (owner: Ben)
4) Service account pattern + provisioning steps for CI/CD + automation (owner: Marissa)
5) Deliverables & timeline + who needs to sign off on our SOC/attestations

Proposed times (PST): Mon 11/22 10:00am, 2:00pm or Tue 11/23 11:00am. Which works for your engineering and security team?

Also: Karthik, when you reply please paste the SAML EntityID and ACS we should expect so they can pre-configure. Neha — can you draft a minimal SCIM attribute map we can circulate? I've dropped the RFI into our shared drive link (see related_links).

- Ben

Thanks Maria — happy to drive the mutual action plan (MAP). Below is a compact MAP we can use in the handshake and then expand into a shared checklist: 

- Day 0 (this thread): confirm owners and schedule technical handshake (owner: Ben)
- Day 1 (handshake): exchange SAML metadata, confirm ACS + cert (owner: Karthik)
- Day 2–3: SCIM attribute map review and test account provisioning (owner: Neha)
- Day 3–7: IP allowlist confirmation + test callbacks to staging endpoints (owner: Ben)
- Day 7–14: Service account provisioning for integrations + RBAC review (owner: Marissa)
- Deliverable: Completed RFI + evidence pack (certs, config screenshots, test logs) for FinServCo security team

Quick asks for the handshake:
- Maria: who will be the FinServCo SAML admin (name + email)?
- Maria: please confirm the staging ACS URL we should use to validate callbacks (if different from prod)
- Maria: any org policies that must be in place before go-live (e.g., 90-day key rotation, disabled external sharing)?

I will own the service-account runbook and provide a sample Terraform snippet to create the least-privileged service principal we recommend. I'll upload the draft runbook to the shared drive before the call.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi all — following up with the technical checklist and example values so FinServCo can pre-configure and run the staging test after the handshake.

1) SAML (minimum fields we publish):
   - EntityID: https://accounts.redwood.com/saml/metadata
   - ACS URL (staging): https://staging.accounts.redwood.com/saml/acs
   - Cert: attached saml-metadata.xml (contains public cert and signing algorithm)
   - Suggested session timeout: 8 hours; recommend 5 minute clock skew allowance

2) SCIM provisioning:
   - Supported attributes: userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], groups (push)
   - Provisioning mode: delta patch / bulk initial sync supported
   - SCIM endpoint (staging): https://staging.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/
   - Rate guidance: 10 reqs/sec for initial sync; 1 req/sec for provisioning deltas

3) IP allowlist (admin console & callback origins):
   - Redwood outbound: 52.12.34.0/24, 34.56.78.90/32
   - If you run strict egress filtering for callbacks, please allow the staging callback host staging.api.redwood.com (resolves to the above ranges)

4) Service accounts & RBAC pattern:
   - Pattern: create a tenant-scoped service principal with role "redwood-infer-ingest" and limit scopes to the ingest endpoint only
   - Short-lived tokens (recommended) or long-lived keys rotated every 30 days (if your policy requires static creds)
   - We will provide a Terraform example and a minimal IAM policy (I will upload after this message)

5) Evidence pack we can provide immediately:
   - SAML metadata + cert (attached)
   - SCIM attribute mapping doc (draft will be in drive)
   - Sample test logs from a recent staging SAML login (we can redact tenant names)

Next steps: Ben, please confirm the handshake slot — I tentatively booked Tue 11/23 11:00am PST (30m). Maria, if that works for your engineers I will drop a calendar invite and include pre-reads.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
